content:
We need to identify elements based on isotope distribution patterns visible in the mass spectrum. We need the mass spectrum data. Use mass_spectrometry_spectra tool to get spectrum. Then analyze isotopic patterns to identify elements that can be definitively identified. We also have retrieve_isotope_distribution to know isotopic patterns.

We need to look at spectrum peaks and see characteristic isotopic patterns: e.g., chlorine (Cl) shows M+2 ~1/3 intensity of M, bromine (Br) shows M+2 ~1 intensity (approx equal). Sulfur shows M+2 ~4% of M (due to 34S). Carbon shows M+1 pattern due to 13C ~1.1% per carbon. Hydrogen shows M+1 due to deuterium negligible. Nitrogen shows M+1 ~0.37% per N. Oxygen shows M+2 due to 18O ~0.2% per O. Fluorine has only one stable isotope. Iodine only one.

Thus we need to examine spectrum for these patterns. Let's get spectrum.
